newsitem.title: USA: Pall says sales up, expects higher Q1 shr.
newsitem.headline: Pall says sales up, expects higher Q1 shr.

text.p: Pall Corp said on Tuesday that earnings for the first quarter, which will be released on December 2, are expected to be about $0.18 per share, an increase of 12.5 percent over $0.16 per share for the first quarter of last year.
In a release on Tuesday, Pall Corp said overall sales for the first quarter of fiscal 1997 increased 8.5 percent to $207,478,000, compared with $191,550,000 for the first quarter of last year.

A company executive said in the release that goals for fiscal 1997 are to achieve 10 to 15 percent unit and price growth in sales and achieve earnings growth in the range of 15 to 20 percent, although both are expected to be at the lower end of the range.
He cited lower growth in microelectronics, combined with general weakness in the European economies. He added that current exchange rates are expected to reduce sales by one percent for the year.
